title: Visible EXP
description: Serverside datapack that shows EXP gains and losses to players
body:
Server-side, lightweight datapack that shows players the exact amount of XP on gains or losses, with an optional tracker for the amount of remaining experience until the next or a specific level.

*Note: If the display does not trigger when you think it should, you might have damaged pieces of Mending equipment that the XP is repairing. The display only counts XP banked in your player level.*

All players have access to the following commands, which work on each player individually:
- `/trigger vxp_toggle` - Toggles the display on or off.
- `/trigger vxp_set_target` - Shows help for the set_target command
- `/trigger vxp_set_target set <LEVEL>` - Sets the target level for the level tracker.
  - Set to -1 to display XP to *next level*
  - Set to 0 to *disable level tracking*
  - Set to any positive integer to set XP target to that level
